lines.en: : Pay attention, Yasu! For this tutorial is not repeatable!
lines.zh: : 看好了，Yasu！因为这段教学是不可重复的！

lines.en: : I will do my best to not disappoint you, Master!
lines.zh: : 我会尽全力不让您失望，师父！

lines.en: : Um...Molly? Why is Yasu suddenly calling you “Master?”
lines.zh: : 呃……Molly？Yasu 为什么突然叫你「师父」？

lines.en: : Because, dearest Xessaxia, I have {i}become{/i} her master! And have decided that it is in the best interest of the manga club if she takes after me in every way imaginable!
lines.zh: : 因为，亲爱的 Xessaxia，我已经{i}成了{/i}她的师父！而且我认为，让她在一切可以想象的方面都效仿我，才最符合漫画社的利益！

lines.en: : With the one minor exception that she may continue to believe in her god as it was the one area she was not willing to budge on.
lines.zh: : 唯一的例外是她可以继续信仰她的神，因为那是她唯一不肯让步的领域。

lines.en: : It was an easy decision when every other aspect of me is unworthy and unlovable.
lines.zh: : 反正我其他方面都不配被爱、也不值得被爱，这个决定很容易下。

lines.en: : But...you don’t know how to play volleyball, Molly. You don’t even go outside.
lines.zh: : 可是……你根本不会打排球啊，Molly。你连门都不出。

lines.en: : Correct, Xessaxia! Which is why my first course of action is teaching Yasu how to adapt when she {i}is{/i} forced to associate with normies!
lines.zh: : 没错，Xessaxia！所以我的首要任务，就是教 Yasu 在{i}被迫{/i}与凡人打交道时该如何适应！

lines.en: : Molly! Just serve the damn ball! How long are ya plannin’ on makin’ us wait!
lines.zh: : Molly！你倒是快发球啊！你打算让我们等到什么时候！

lines.en: : You see, Yasu- sometimes, people will expect things of you that you simply cannot do! And, in moments like that, you must do your best to not let them down!
lines.zh: : 你瞧，Yasu——有时候，人们会对你抱有你根本做不到的期待！而在那样的时刻，你必须尽力不让他们失望！

lines.en: : So the only course of action is to create your {i}own{/i} game! One not bound by the confines of what those unlike us {i}expect!{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以唯一的做法，就是创造出属于你{i}自己{/i}的游戏！一个不受那些与我们不同之人的{i}期待{/i}所束缚的游戏！

lines.en: : Is that...really the {i}only{/i} course of action?
lines.zh: : 这……真的是{i}唯一{/i}的做法吗？

lines.en: : This is not volleyball, Yasu! This is...demon ball!
lines.zh: : 这不是排球，Yasu！这是……驱魔球！

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m allowed to play this game anymore.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我已经不被允许玩这个游戏了。

lines.en: Futaba Fukuyama was one of just several girls currently engaged (or {i}supposed{/i} to be engaged) in a casual game of beach volleyball.
lines.zh: Futaba Fukuyama 是眼前这场沙滩排球友谊赛（或者说{i}本该{/i}在打的友谊赛）中的几个女孩之一。

lines.en: And while athletics were certainly not her strong suit, she didn’t mind participating in things like this as the expectations placed on her were rather low.
lines.zh: 虽说运动绝对不是她的强项，但她并不介意参加这种活动，毕竟大家对她也没什么期待。

lines.en: It was a bit demoralizing, sure. But if there’s anything that anyone knows about volleyball in class-type settings, it’s that there will always be weak links who just try to avoid the ball at all costs.
lines.zh: 当然，这有点打击士气。不过说到班级性质的排球赛，谁都知道一个道理——总会有那么几个薄弱环节，只想不惜一切代价躲开球。
而她就是那个环节！

lines.en: But today, fate had other plans.
lines.zh: 但今天，命运另有安排。

lines.en: : ...and that’s how you play demon ball!
lines.zh: : ……驱魔球就是这么玩的！

lines.en: : I understand! May I attempt to expel evil from the ball’s nucleus now?
lines.zh: : 我懂了！现在我可以试着把球核里的邪祟驱逐出来了吗？
: 得排在我后面，Yasu！

lines.en: : Someone just serve the damn ball already! I’m freakin’ out over here!
lines.zh: : 谁来发个该死的球行不行！我在这儿快疯了！

lines.en: : In the name of the Tuatha Dé Danann, I serve- no. I exorcise thee! Hah!
lines.zh: : 以 Tuatha Dé Danann 之名，我发——不。我驱魔！哈！

lines.en: : THAT’S NOT EVEN THE RIGHT DIRECTION!!!
lines.zh: : 那根本不是正确的方向啊啊啊！！！
: F……Futaba！小心！
: 呜哇啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！
: 愿你的恶魔被驱逐！

lines.en: : I don’t have any demons! I don’t even like-
lines.zh: : 我身上没有恶魔！我甚至都不喜——
Futaba 被击中了。
Futaba 死了。
Futaba 重生了。
: 它没打中我吗？……
: 我是不是——
: 我并没有……真的{i}死掉{/i}……对吧？……

lines.en: : I know I’m not good at volleyball, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道我排球打得很烂，可是……

lines.en: : No...of course I’m not {i}dead.{/i} I’m...probably just unconscious or something. And this is a dream.
lines.zh: : 不……我当然没{i}死。{/i}我……大概只是昏过去了什么的。这只是个梦。

lines.en: : But if it’s a dream...I shouldn’t {i}know{/i} that it’s a dream...so-
lines.zh: : 可如果这是梦……我就不该{i}知道{/i}自己在做梦……所以——
: {i}看看你的四周……{/i}

lines.en: : What?! Who’s there?! Who said that?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！谁在那儿？！是谁在说话？！
: 是{i}你{/i}自己说的……

lines.en: There is no you in you and me but there is me in you
lines.zh: 你与我之中没有你，但你之中有我

lines.en: This normally ends differently, but different isn’t true
lines.zh: 这一切本该以另一种方式收场，可不同并非真实

lines.en: So lie until your tongue falls off and scream your favorite song
lines.zh: 那就撒谎，直到舌头脱落，再尖声唱出你最爱的歌

lines.en: Then fill your hands with broken glass and squeeze until they’re gone
lines.zh: 然后把双手装满碎玻璃，紧握直到它们消失不见
: 它是倒过来的……

lines.en: : The current time is 11:19 PM. Today’s weather is expected to be complete within the next hour. Your name is Futaba Fukuyama. You are happy here.
lines.zh: : 当前时间是晚上 11:19。今天的天气预计将在一小时内完成。你叫 Futaba Fukuyama。你在这里很幸福。
: 怎么……什么……哈？哈？！！

lines.en: : There are ghosts inside this building. They will attempt to speak to you. Do not look at them. Do not answer them. Do not pass go. Do not collect $200.
lines.zh: : 这栋建筑里有幽灵。它们会试图与你说话。不要看它们。不要回答它们。不要经过起点。不要收下 200 美元。

lines.en: : Your attendance is requested for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium. Please come to the library for further details.
lines.zh: : 请您出席跨太平洋悲伤研讨会。详情请前往图书馆。

lines.en: : Assistance will be provided if you can not find your egg.
lines.zh: : 若您找不到您的卵，我们将提供协助。

lines.en: : What egg?! What is this?! What are you talking about?!
lines.zh: : 什么卵？！这是什么？！你到底在说什么？！

lines.en: : The egg that will guarantee your selection. The one that hums in your hand and not in your mouth. Assistance will be provided if you can not find your egg.
lines.zh: : 那枚能确保您被选中的卵。在您手中嗡鸣，而非在您口中嗡鸣的那枚。若您找不到您的卵，我们将提供协助。

lines.en: : I would like to wake up now...
lines.zh: : 我想醒过来了……
: {i}哈……哈啊……啊！对！我要去了……又去了！又！啊……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！{/i}
: Nodoka？……
: {i}不要……理会那呼唤……{/i}
: 是谁？！现……现身吧！
: {i}无人……亦无物……{/i}
: {i}所有人……以及一切……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You are not safe here...they will claim you...they will complete you...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在这里不安全……它们会占有你……它们会完成你……{/i}

lines.en: : Wha...what do you mean they’ll...{i}complete{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 什……什么叫它们会……{i}完成{/i}我？

lines.en: : {i}You are...the unfinished you...the last silken thread...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是……尚未完成的你……最后一根丝线……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}They will take you...tear you apart...learn how your body works...and you will become the model from which all else comes to fruition...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它们会带走你……把你拆开……弄清你身体的运作方式……而你将成为万物流变所参照的模型……{/i}

lines.en: : I have no idea what that means! What is this place?! Where am I?!
lines.zh: : 我完全不明白这是什么意思！这是什么地方？！我在哪儿？！
: {i}你很清楚自己在哪儿……{/i}
: {i}一个叠在你自己世界之上的世界……{/i}
: {i}只是朝向了新的方向……{/i}

lines.en: Futaba Fukuyama manages to complete the maze and eventually makes it to the library...but she broke several rules along the way.
lines.zh: Futaba Fukuyama 总算走完了迷宫，最终抵达图书馆……但她在路上违反了好几条规则。

lines.en: The ghosts that followed her and lied to her became entities that she fooled herself into trusting. But each time she spoke back to them, she lost a part of herself.
lines.zh: 那些跟着她、对她撒谎的幽灵，变成了她自欺欺人地信任的存在。但每一次回话，她都失去了一部分自己。

lines.en: These parts grew into additional Futaba Fukuyamas. Better ones. Ones that knew how to follow directions and saw themselves not as monsters but as angels.
lines.zh: 这些碎片长成了更多的 Futaba Fukuyama。更好的那些。懂得听从指示，不把自己看作怪物而看作天使的那些。

lines.en: They surrounded her, skin glistening in the anti-sun, and stared through her eyes and into each others.
lines.zh: 它们围住她，皮肤在反太阳下泛着光，透过她的眼睛，凝视着彼此。

lines.en: Futaba Fukuyama (the original [[?]) felt intimidated by their presence. But, in a strange way, she found it easier looking at {i}them{/i} than she did her own reflection.
lines.zh: 最初的 Futaba Fukuyama（？）被它们的存在震慑住了。但奇怪的是，她觉得看着{i}它们{/i}，比看着镜中的自己要容易得多。

lines.en: These conflicted feelings were subsequently replaced by looming dread as a figure began to sprout in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: 随后，当房间角落里开始生长出一个人影时，这些矛盾的感受被逼近的恐惧取代了。

lines.en: And while she could not see the figure yet as she fended off her shadows, it saw her. And it cried, for that was all it knew how to do.
lines.zh: 她还看不见那个人影——她正忙于抵挡自己的影子——但它看得见她。而它哭了，因为那是它唯一会做的事。

lines.en: It had existed in this space in time for as long as time had existed, and all it knew was pain. Scorn. It was the scapegoat the other ghosts would carve their names into. A scorned half-god.
lines.zh: 自有时间以来，它就存在于这个时空里，而它所知道的一切只有痛苦。轻蔑。它是其他幽灵刻下名字的替罪羊。一位被轻蔑的半神。

lines.en: And it watched in all its untapped fury as Futaba Fukuyama (the original [[?]) conversed with herself.
lines.zh: 它怀着从未施展的愤怒注视着最初的 Futaba Fukuyama（？）与她自己对话。
: 什么……怎么会？……为什么？……

lines.en: : What does any of this even mean?...When am I going to wake up?...
lines.zh: : 这一切到底是什么意思？……我什么时候才能醒过来？……

lines.en: : {i}Here forever, special girl! No matter what you do!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}永远困在这里吧，特别的女孩！无论你做什么都一样！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You can change yourself a million times, but you’ll never feel like you!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你可以把自己改变一百万次，却永远感觉不像你自己！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Each time your fingers find your mouth, you give away a piece-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}每一次你的手指伸向嘴巴，你就交出了一块——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Of sanity! Humanity! A chance to be complete!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}理智！人性！以及变得完整的机会！{/i}

lines.en: She knew what they were saying because she wasn’t a fucking moron like you. She’d cleaned blood off her roommate, Occam’s, razor before and wasn’t perplexed by neglected complexities.
lines.zh: 她听得懂它们在说什么，因为她不像你他妈的是个白痴。她以前替室友 Occam 清理过剃刀上的血迹，对那些被忽视的复杂之处并不困惑。

lines.en: She was part of the codex — an abject auspex practicing breakneck safe sex, slipping objects in the convex annexes of each attic in the narthex.
lines.zh: 她是抄本的一部分——一位卑贱的占卜官，以玩命的姿态实践安全性行为，把物件塞进前廊里每间阁楼的凸面附属空间。

lines.en: She didn’t care about the effects. She paid no mind to things like that as she was too busy swimming in doubt and cum and more doubt and more cum and you were-
lines.zh: 她不在乎后果。她根本不去想那些事，因为她正忙于在怀疑与精液、更多的怀疑与更多的精液里游泳，而你在——
你{i}到底{/i}在做什么？

lines.en: I watched you last night. And I didn’t quite understand.
lines.zh: 我昨晚看着你。我没怎么看懂。

lines.en: Please write your actions down on a piece of construction paper and slip it into my PO{s}x{/s} box so I can come closer to replicating you for my next art installment.
lines.zh: 请把你的行为写在一张硬纸板上，塞进我的 PO 信箱，好让我在下一件艺术装置里更接近地复制你。

lines.en: : {i}X marks the praetor — a letter of love.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}X 标记着执政官——一封情书。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The most shameful of angels in gardens above.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}天上花园里最可耻的天使。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know the way out, you can still be complete{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道出去的路，你依然可以变得完整{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re a fat fucking bitch but I’d lick both your feet.{/b}
lines.zh: : {i}你是个死胖婊子，但我愿意舔你的两只脚。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}AHHHHAHHAHAHAHAHAH! LOOK AT THE LOOK OF HER LOOK! HER FEELINGS ARE CRAB LEGS INSIDE OF A BOOK!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！看看她那副表情的表情！她的感情就是书里的蟹腿！{/i}

lines.en: : Okay...I think I might need to see a therapist. I am clearly broken. This isn’t normal.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我觉得我可能需要看心理医生了。我显然是坏掉了。这太不正常了。
: 我就……找到那枚{i}卵{/i}，然后……

lines.en: It was then that she noticed the sprout that had sprouted. The flower of Eden in a forest so shrouded-
lines.zh: 就在那时，她注意到了那株已经长出来的幼芽。伊甸之花，生长在一片如此幽暗的森林里——

lines.en: by evil and weevils, such a feeble upheaval! How depressing undressing for the cruelest of peoples!
lines.zh: 为邪恶与象鼻虫所遮蔽，如此无力的剧变！为最残忍的人们宽衣解带，何其可悲！

lines.en: Futaba Fukuyama (the original [[?]) broke another rule. She spoke to the unspoken. She had doomed herself to a lifetime worth of unexpected taxes and a low-calcium diet.
lines.zh: 最初的 Futaba Fukuyama（？）又违反了一条规则。她对不可言说之物开了口。她把自己判给了一辈子的意外税费和低钙饮食。

lines.en: She would also be brutally violated by at least one animal before leaving this place. But the animals were nice here so she probably wouldn’t mind it.
lines.zh: 在离开这里之前，她还会被至少一只动物粗暴地侵犯。不过这里的动物都很友善，所以她大概也不会介意。
: 也许这只是一尊……雕像？
: 原来你{i}真的{/i}怕我……

lines.en: : What? No! I just...wasn’t expecting you to talk. You were so quiet just a second ago...
lines.zh: : 什么？没有！我只是……没想到你会说话。你刚才还那么安静……
: 那……你不怕我？……

lines.en: : I’m...a little scared of everything right now. I’ve never had a dream like this before. But you...seem nice?...
lines.zh: : 我现在……什么都怕一点。我从没做过这样的梦。但你……看起来挺温和的？……

lines.en: : Yeah...everyone else is...being cryptic and...{i}mean.{/i} But you’re just...minding your own business. So...thank you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……其他人都在……说着莫名其妙的话，而且很{i}刻薄。{/i}可你只是在……做自己的事。所以……谢谢你？
: 你在……谢我？……

lines.en: : Yeah...but...it would also...be really nice if you could tell me what I’m supposed to do here?
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过……要是你也能告诉我，我在这儿该做什么，那就更好了？

lines.en: : Did they give you a job?...
lines.zh: : 它们给了你任务？……

lines.en: : I...I think so, but...but do you know who {i}they{/i} are? And why I need an egg?
lines.zh: : 我……我想是的，不过……不过你知道{i}它们{/i}是谁吗？还有我为什么需要一枚卵？

lines.en: : They’re the ones who put me in here...
lines.zh: : 是它们把我关在这儿的……

lines.en: : They said my hands were too large. That I don’t look like the others. That I can not be completed...
lines.zh: : 它们说我的手太大了。说我长得和别人不一样。说我无法被完成……

lines.en: : Just...because your hands are a little big?
lines.zh: : 就……因为你的手有点大？

lines.en: : It’s hard for me to walk...I’ll only slow them down...
lines.zh: : 我走路很困难……只会拖慢它们……

lines.en: : So I’m better off in here...where I won’t be a burden to anyone...
lines.zh: : 所以我待在这儿更好……在这儿我不会成为任何人的负担……
: 我喜欢你的手……
: 真的吗？……
: 当然……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Because they’re yours...and because there’s nothing wrong with being a little different.
lines.zh: : 因为那是你的手……也因为有点不一样并没什么不好。
: 这……真是你的想法吗？……

lines.en: : For everyone but me at least. Frankly, I wish I was a little more “normal” when it comes to the way I look.
lines.zh: : 至少对别人我是这么想的。说实话，我真希望自己的长相能更「正常」一点。

lines.en: : Are they going to lock you in here with me?...
lines.zh: : 它们会把我跟你一起关在这儿吗？……
: 希望不会……

lines.en: : It’s nothing against you. I think I just like my world a little bit more.
lines.zh: : 我不是针对你。我只是更喜欢我自己的世界一点。

lines.en: : Can you tell me about it?...What makes your world so special?...
lines.zh: : 能跟我说说吗？……你的世界为什么那么特别？……
: 主要是生活在里面的人。

lines.en: : I have a lot of people I really care about. And they’re really stubborn when it comes to trying to make me feel like I belong sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有很多真正在乎的人。他们有时候特别执拗地想让我觉得自己属于那里。

lines.en: : It makes things...really hard, actually. But I do appreciate them for it. And I know their hearts are in the right place.
lines.zh: : 说实话这让事情……挺难的。但我确实感激他们。我也知道他们的出发点是好的。
: 这些……{i}人……{/i}他们是人类吗？
: 是的，他们——
: 怎么了吗？……
: 看起来……突然变得{i}不一样{/i}了……
: 不一样？……
: 真奇怪……
: 我没觉得自己有什么不同……

lines.en: : My hands are still too heavy to lift...
lines.zh: : 我的手还是沉重得抬不起来……

lines.en: : Can you...tell me more about the people you love?...
lines.zh: : 你能……再多说些你爱的人吗？……

lines.en: : I wish...to love too...one day...but I...don’t know how...
lines.zh: : 我也想……有一天能去爱……可是我……不知道怎么爱……

lines.en: : I have a better idea, actually...
lines.zh: : 其实我有个更好的主意……

lines.en: : Why don’t you come with me? We can look for my egg together.
lines.zh: : 你要不要跟我一起走？我们可以一起去寻找我的卵。

lines.en: : But I...can’t walk...my hands...they’re too heavy...
lines.zh: : 可是我……走不了……我的手……太沉了……

lines.en: : When was the last time you tried?
lines.zh: : 你上一次试着走是什么时候？
: 很……很久以前了……

lines.en: : You’ve been here a while, huh?...
lines.zh: : 你在这儿待了很久了吧？……
: 我不被允许……离开……

lines.en: : I’ll scare...the others...I’ll be...the greatest burden known to man...
lines.zh: : 我会吓到……其他人……我会成为……人类已知最沉重的负担……

lines.en: : These halls...are not meant for those like me...for those...not meant to be here...
lines.zh: : 这些厅堂……不是为像我这样的人准备的……为那些……本就不该在这里的人……
: 未完成的……被抛弃的……被轻蔑的……

lines.en: : If you won’t fit in here, all you really have to do is find a place where you {i}will.{/i}
lines.zh: : 既然这里容不下你，那你真正要做的，就是去找一个{i}容得下{/i}你的地方。
: 那样的……地方……存在吗？……

lines.en: : Come with me...we can find out together...
lines.zh: : 跟我走吧……我们可以一起去弄清楚……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Why are you...so nice to me?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么……对我这么好？……
: 因为大家一直都对{i}我{/i}很好。

lines.en: : Well...maybe not {i}everyone.{/i} But most people. And so the least I can do is repay that kindness.
lines.zh: : 好吧……也许不是{i}所有人{/i}。但大多数人是。所以我能做的至少是把这份善意还回去。
: 我做不到……
: 离开这里……只会伤害你……
: 而你……不该承受……那样的痛苦……

lines.en: : What are you talking about? You’re not going to {i}hurt{/i} me. Just take my hand and we can explore this place together.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么呀？你不会{i}伤害{/i}我的。牵住我的手，我们可以一起探索这个地方。

lines.en: : It is not me...who will hurt you...it is {i}them...{/i}
lines.zh: : 要伤害你的……不是我……是{i}它们……{/i}
: 它们在{i}看着……{/i}它们就在{i}这里……{/i}

lines.en: : There’s no one here but us. Everything is going to be-
lines.zh: : 这里除了我们没有别人。一切都会——
: 嗨！你在干什么呀？

lines.en: : You shouldn’t touch that thing. It’s dangerous and ugly. How did it escape its chains, I wonder?
lines.zh: : 你不该碰那个东西。它又危险又丑。它是怎么挣脱锁链的呢，我很好奇。
: ……Maya？
: {i}Maya{/i}？……
: 那是谁？

lines.en: : But even more importantly, who are {i}you?{/i} You’re not supposed to be here. This area is for members only.
lines.zh: : 但更重要的是，{i}你{/i}又是谁？你本不该在这里。这片区域仅限会员进入。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like I {i}want{/i} to be here! I got hit by a volleyball and all of a sudden I was-
lines.zh: : 我又不是{i}想{/i}来这儿的！我被排球砸了一下，然后突然就——
: 了解！家に帰ろう！ (明白！回家吧！)
